description: $0.007 — Timing a large order? A check costing at most $0.01 tells you whether to execute now or wait. Scores the current window 0-100 from trading session, regime, Fear & Greed and volatility, and returns EXECUTE_NOW / GOOD_WINDOW / WAIT_15MIN / WAIT_SESSION with a recommended order type and the next favourable window. Not size-aware: pair with slippage_forecast for the cost of your exact order. Param: coin (default BTC).
name: execution_window_optimizer
